lessons.title: Game: Hello Computer Challenge
objectives: Learn that code can control characters and objects
lessons.content:
Game Title: Hello Computer Challenge with Codey the Robot

Setting: Rainbow Code Kingdom

How to Play:
- Players help Codey the Robot complete fun tasks related to Hello Computer.
- Each successful action earns stars and points.
- There are 3–5 levels of increasing challenge suitable for ages 5-6.
- Visual and sound feedback celebrate every success.
- A friendly helper character gives hints when needed.

Win Condition: Collect enough stars to unlock the next lesson and a special badge.

This game reinforces Hello Computer through playful repetition and immediate positive feedback.
lessons.gamification: Earn 16 XP + 9 points. Unlock progress toward next level. Possible badge: 'Hello Computer Star'. Contributes to daily/weekly quests. Celebration animation on completion. Streak bonus eligible.
lessons.parent_tip: Ask your child: 'What was your favorite part about helping Codey the Robot?'

lessons.title: Commands & Sequences: Pixel the Fox's Adventure #1
objectives: Understand that computers follow step-by-step instructions
lessons.content:
The magical Pixel Forest was home to Pixel the Fox, who was about to learn a super important lesson...

In this adventure, Pixel the Fox learns all about "Commands & Sequences". 

The story follows Pixel the Fox as they explore Pixel Forest and discover important ideas through fun challenges and friendly helpers.

Key moments:
1. Meeting a new friend who introduces the main idea
2. Facing a small challenge related to Commands & Sequences
3. Trying different approaches and learning from mistakes
4. Celebrating success and sharing the new knowledge

The story ends with Pixel the Fox feeling proud and ready to use what they learned in the real world. Parents can ask: "What would you do if you were Pixel the Fox?"

Age-appropriate language, short sentences, and lots of encouragement make this perfect for ages 4-9.
lessons.gamification: Earn 11 XP + 6 points. Unlock progress toward next level. Possible badge: 'Commands & Sequences Star'. Contributes to daily/weekly quests. Celebration animation on completion. Streak bonus eligible.
lessons.parent_tip: Replay the activity together and take turns.

lessons.title: Ocean Life: Captain Cosmos's Adventure #10
objectives: Explore cause and effect in simple experiments
lessons.content:
Deep in Space Observatory, a curious little Captain Cosmos had a big question...

In this adventure, Captain Cosmos learns all about "Ocean Life". 

The story follows Captain Cosmos as they explore Space Observatory and discover important ideas through fun challenges and friendly helpers.

Key moments:
1. Meeting a new friend who introduces the main idea
2. Facing a small challenge related to Ocean Life
3. Trying different approaches and learning from mistakes
4. Celebrating success and sharing the new knowledge

The story ends with Captain Cosmos feeling proud and ready to use what they learned in the real world. Parents can ask: "What would you do if you were Captain Cosmos?"

Age-appropriate language, short sentences, and lots of encouragement make this perfect for ages 5-7.
